affectedPublicSurfaces: the release path for demo.app-juli.com and api.app-juli.com, and the future landing surface: every deployed release becomes a CI-produced artifact rather than a server-side build

candidateVerificationJourney.restrictedRoute: CI runners only; the artifact is built and verified in continuous integration and is not delivered to the server in this slice, so no candidate instance and no public traffic are involved

journeys.name: artifact-is-produced-and-traceable
journeys.entryUrl: CI: the artifact build job for each deployable
assertions: an artifact is produced for each deployable
the artifact records the exact commit it was built from, and that commit is recoverable from the artifact alone
the artifact carries the shape ADR-058 fixed: the built output and its production dependency tree, resolved in CI

journeys.name: browser-level-checks-run-in-ci-against-the-artifact
journeys.entryUrl: CI: a server started from the artifact, driven by a real browser
assertions: computed styling is asserted, not merely that a stylesheet responded
interactivity is asserted on at least one core interaction
these checks run before the artifact is publishable, and are the deliberate counterpart to the protocol-level on-server checks in #833

journeys.name: a-failed-build-publishes-nothing
assertions: no artifact is produced or published when the build fails
no artifact is produced when the browser-level checks fail
the job exits non-zero and the failure is visible rather than silent

journeys.name: the-server-no-longer-compiles
journeys.entryUrl: repository: the deploy scripts the server executes
assertions: no application build step remains in what the server runs
dependency resolution happens in CI, not on the server, per ADR-058
the existing per-app deploy path still works until #844 retires it

migrationCompatibility.notes: The slice changes where builds happen. It touches no database, queue, or persistence surface.

rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: the existing per-application deploy scripts remain functional throughout this slice, so reverting the commit restores the current server-side build path exactly

doNotInfer: delivering the artifact to the server, starting a candidate from it, or any cutover — those are #838 and #841
removing the per-application deploy scripts; #844 retires them only after the combined path has completed a real release
switching to self-contained build output; ADR-058 fixed the packaging shape and this slice produces that shape
pulling protocol-level asset checks out of #833 into CI, or browser-level checks out of CI onto the server — the split is deliberate
database, queue, or TikTok integration changes
